title: 7th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/2/2026 to 3/2/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for President of the Elections Commission, under Article 7(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Act on becoming a resident of an island in the Maldives (Law No. 46/78), submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Continuation of the debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved earlier minutes, sent the Elections Commission president nominee to committee, opened debate on a bill amending the island residency law, and continued debating the digital transformation and digital identity bills.
